_agentDefinition.purpose: Expands repeating cycle patterns (e.g., 'Cycles 1-6, Day 1 of each 21-day cycle') into individual visit instances, enabling complete schedule generation.
_agentDefinition.extractionMethodology: Cycle pattern detection from visit/epoch headers. LLM interpretation of cycle descriptions (duration, repetition count). Visit instance generation with proper sequencing. Handling of variable cycle counts (until PD, max N cycles).

keyOutputs.description: Individual visit instances for each cycle
Length of each cycle in days
Maximum number of cycles or 'until progression'

downstreamIntegrations.automationExample: EDC generates C1D1, C1D8, C1D15, C2D1, C2D8... form instances automatically
IRT calculates drug supply: 6 cycles x 21 days = 126 days supply per subject

downstreamIntegrations.useCase: Expected visit count for enrollment planning
downstreamIntegrations.automationExample: CTMS forecasts: 100 subjects x 6 cycles x 3 visits/cycle = 1800 expected visits
Patient app shows: 'Your next visit: Cycle 3, Day 1 (approximately March 15)'

automationInsights.description: Cycle expansion creates complete EDC visit structure automatically
Cycle count drives drug and kit supply calculations
Max cycles determine expected study duration for planning

dataQualityIndicators: max cycles is defined or 'until PD'
